## Purpose and admission status

Reconcile reviewed SWARM-004 reciprocal native assembly and its Workbench composer, plus SWARM-005 source-feasible terminal parts and source-bound MOSAIC receptors, with accepted main.

**Draft / HOLD.** Hosted resulting-source qualification, guarded runtime publication, independent final evidence review and the new package's physical owner acceptance remain admission gates. No auto-merge. The owner authorizes manual merge only after all mandatory gates pass.

## Resulting behavior and demonstrated repairs

The ordinary Shared Workbench exposes a lazy **Reciprocal assembly…** dock labelled **Experimental · FRAMEWEAVER × MOSAIC**. Opening it does not generate or mutate World. Both SWARM-005 controls start OFF.

- Pending numeric text and initial territory gestures retire stale Apply authority; actions commit focused text.
- Busy territory input cannot fall through to native Paint; failed runtime admission cannot preserve an earlier applicable preview.
- Receptor candidate, footprint and finalization work is charged against the original bounded allowance; cancellation/exhaustion publishes no partial receptors.
- Ordinary Linux/Windows packages receive OS-specific source-bound reciprocal CLIs. Present stale platform bindings fail closed.
- Target-platform LFS packaging and Linux executable permissions are preserved.
- Five CLI console-output sites use C stdio to retain the existing Linux symbol ceiling; native JSON and generation semantics are unchanged.
- Both source platforms test verified committed installations outside the checkout, so Godot-generated UID files cannot invalidate or weaken source custody.
- Reviewed historical Workbench definitions remain inspectable through a separate read-only path; original maps, receipts and raw `can_apply` evidence stay intact. Only successful fresh current-source generation can restore transaction authority.
- Source/evaluator archives preserve canonical committed text, explicit attributes, binary bytes and all import sidecars without weakening sealed hashes or altering Git configuration.
- #700 registration is retained, required guide metadata repaired and current integration documentation registered.

Accepted 80 Genteks, Wave/Water, Paint/SCRIPT-HOTPATH, Art/history/Flatten, actors and historical saves remain the baseline. No new native material, solver allowance or geometric recovery policy. The Linux standalone CLI uses its own supported older libstdc++ string ABI; the GDExtension ABI and existing Linux compatibility floor are unchanged.

## Preflight and review

The first frozen source's local strict native suites passed: assembly 99,729; MOSAIC 8/8 and 274,661; reciprocal 263,015; SWARM-005 7/7 and 42 assertions. The same suites passed ASan/UBSan with local leak detection disabled. Native parser 13/13 with zero skips, V3 positive/blocked/malformed cases, and authoring-patch 131,158 checks passed.

Exact Godot 4.7 local source-built preflight passed protocol 140, adapter 126, controller 33, controls 32, loader 12, no-environment packaged controls 32, create/Undo/Save/fresh-reopen, blocked and lifecycle cases. These were **headless GCC 14 diagnostics**, not hosted qualification. Validation contracts 41 passed.

Independent native/protocol/input, loader/provenance and CI/publication/package source reviews report GO to frozen-source qualification after confirmed P2 repairs. Final exact-source hosted evidence review is still required. The r2 delta independently passed the 25 helper tests and exact source review; its 60-second graphical startup gate is unchanged.

[R1 failed qualification](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/actions/runs/44947666723) is retained: Linux refused a GLIBCXX3.4.32 CLI import; Windows source passed all 14 child processes then correctly refused generated UID files in the checkout; the extracted evaluator exceeded its cold-start bound. The first two causes are repaired in r2. All 34 source/package shader-cache files match; cold software palette compilation is supported by the diagnostics, while the exact host timing factor is unproved. R2 did not repeat the cold-start failure: its extracted graphical aggregate passed with the unchanged 60-second bound. A future repeat requires a bounded same-host diagnostic, not retries until green.

[R2 qualification](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/actions/runs/44950154534) completed in 29m05s. Both source platforms fully passed, including Linux sanitizers and all 17 accepted-main smokes on each platform. The extracted package graphical aggregate passed, but its subsequent smoke admission correctly refused four `.import` files changed by Windows Git archive CRLF conversion and Godot canonicalization. Publication was skipped. The independently reviewed r3 archive repair preserves exact committed bytes rather than relaxing hashes.

Continued independent review also found a historical Inspect regression across native-definition changes; ordinary map restoration remained exact. The r3 repair passed 408 engineer assertions and 259 independently rerun assertions, including genuine older saves and fresh-current-generation recovery. [Committed-source GO](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/blob/395b93393adcc379dabeffeb75be9eb19557ad33/evidence/swarm45-mainline/swarm45-r3-committed-source-review.md) closes that P2 at the exact frozen bytes. These local Linux headless checks do not replace hosted r3 qualification.

## Scientific limits

Historical evidence is not rewritten. SWARM-004 selected holdouts had zero causal fully closed Apply successes. Registered SWARM-005 OFF/OFF and BOTH each reported **1 Complete, 14 Blocked, 21 Exhausted** across 36 cases, with zero newly Apply-valid cases and zero net new qualified joints. Local welded termination remains distinct from a foreign reciprocal joint.

The scoped workflow replays all 360 **already revealed** controls with full native JSON, explicit unavailable closure metrics and source/executable inventories. This is regression/reproduction, not a new unseen holdout or a general-success claim. The runbook records the native-only versus Workbench definition-label discrepancy without altering archived receipts.

[Independent completed local replay review](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/pull/715#issuecomment-7069240111): all 720 candidate/reference outputs and 8,640 historical CSV observations verified; 72/72 receptor-OFF controls normalized-identical. Of 360 pairs, 251 are normalized-identical, 96 change only work counters, one also changes remaining proposal allowance, and twelve change fixed-territory admission/failed-proposal traces. Only case 19 changes final status/joint count (Exhausted → Blocked, four joints, one unresolved obligation, Apply false). The primary negative result remains unchanged.

[Independent hosted r2 native/science audit](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/blob/395b93393adcc379dabeffeb75be9eb19557ad33/evidence/swarm45-mainline/swarm45-science-evidence/swarm45-hosted-r2-scientific-native-review.md) verifies all 360 hosted outputs against the audited local candidates under the same narrow identity normalization, all raw/gzip hashes and exact source/runtime ledgers. No behavior, material, work or failure delta is hidden; primary outcomes remain negative. R3 must still qualify its own original runtime/source identities.

- [ ] New-package physical owner NVIDIA/original 2048² saved-map evaluation required by #698
- [ ] Final live HEAD/base/mergeability verification

Earlier owner evaluation of donor packages does not accept this reconstructed package. If the mandatory owner gate remains unavailable, retain Draft/HOLD with the exact evaluator and missing-gate handoff.

[Current integration and owner procedure](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/blob/integration/swarm004-005-mainline-20261121/docs/operations/swarm45-mainline-integration.md). Exact run/artifact identities and the SWARM-006 successor handoff will follow qualification. #692/#693/#696/#697/#700 are later housekeeping candidates only after successful integration; retain their source branches.
